scope: Independent review of source, statistical interpretation and actual saved-count outputs; no fresh draws or reconstruction.
raw_score_check_design: Three predeclared sampled indices (first, middle, last) in calibration-null/test-null/signal for every profile/factor/hypothesis; independent math.fsum dot product and offset.
interpretation: Known-simple-hypothesis LLR does not establish physical optimality or calibrated nominal tail. Empirical thresholds differ in realized FPR; power comparisons are conditional rather than equal-true-FPR certified. Finite-CSDA alternative is biased surrogate, not stochastic truth; threshold uncertainty and simultaneous coverage omitted.
paired_population_mapping: For factors .5/1/2 reuse original calibration/test/linear populations and extension finite populations; factors4/8/16 use extension populations. Three methods map to exact saved statistic columns.
